theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hb⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ :=
    (Set.finite_Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
      (f := fun n : ℕ => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3)))
      (by
        intro n
        exact ⟨⟨(hb n).1, (hb (n + 1)).1, (hb (n + 2)).1, (hb (n + 3)).1⟩,
          ⟨(hb n).2, (hb (n + 1)).2, (hb (n + 2)).2, (hb (n + 3)).2⟩⟩)
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  have hs : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) ∧
      u (i + m + 1) = u (j + m + 1) ∧
      u (i + m + 2) = u (j + m + 2) ∧
      u (i + m + 3) = u (j + m + 3) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact h
    | succ m ih =>
      refine ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, ?_⟩
      change u (i + m + 4) = u (j + m + 4)
      apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
      rw [(hu (i + m + 4) (by omega)).1, (hu (j + m + 4) (by omega)).1]
      simp [Nat.add_sub_assoc,
        ih.1, ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have he := (hs (n - i)).1.symm
  convert he using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega
